text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF will push towards resistance at 129.16 on Tuesday after breaking out of the top of the recent range in early trade, technical analysts said.

"The key thing for the notionnel was that yesterday and indeed at the end of last week we pushed down to very good 27-month uptrend support and came back above it," David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston in London, said.
He said that trendline comes in at 128.32,34 this session.
At 0820 GMT, June notionnel futures were quoted at 128.98, up 44 basis points in the session.
Sneddon said failure to push decisively below the trendline means the contract has further shorterm upside potential.
Initial price resistance comes in at 129.19, and secondary resistance at 129.26,28. The main upside level comes in at 129.64,68 from price and Fibonacci resistance, he said.
"I think that latter band is as much upside as it will get for the time being," Sneddon said.
On the downside, support surfaces at 128.66 from a small gap on hourly charts and combined with price support at 128.58 should hold the contract for now, he added.
June Pibor futures were quoted at 96.47, up 0.08.
